configurations.name: backend
runtimeArgs: cd backend && source .venv/bin/activate && PYTHONPATH=. uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000

configurations.name: backend-checkout-on
runtimeArgs: cd backend && source .venv/bin/activate && STRIPE_CHECKOUT=on PYTHONPATH=. uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000

configurations.name: backend-integration
runtimeArgs: cd backend && source .venv/bin/activate && export DATABASE_URL=postgresql://sks_lotse:$(grep -E '^DATABASE_URL=' .env | sed -E 's|.*://sks_lotse:([^@]*)@.*|\1|')@localhost:5432/sks_lotse_integration RESEND_API_KEY= ANTHROPIC_GRADING_API_KEY= STRIPE_CHECKOUT=off STRIPE_SECRET_KEY= STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET= ALLOWED_EMAILS= ADMIN_EMAILS=integration-admin@example.com CHART_EXERCISES=admins && alembic upgrade head && PYTHONPATH=. uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000

configurations.name: sbf-dev
runtimeArgs: cd frontend && VITE_SITE=sbf VITE_SBF=off npm run dev -- --port 5174

configurations.name: sbf-dev-accounts
runtimeArgs: cd frontend && VITE_SITE=sbf VITE_SBF=on VITE_SBF_ACCOUNTS=on npm run dev -- --port 5174 --strictPort

configurations.name: sbf-dev-on
runtimeArgs: cd frontend && VITE_SITE=sbf VITE_SBF=on npm run dev -- --port 5175

configurations.name: sbf-preview
runtimeArgs: cd frontend && VITE_SITE=sbf VITE_SBF=off npm run build && npm run preview -- --port 4174
